## Change / 變更

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the agreed issue when applicable.
說明問題及變更後行為；如有相關 Issue，請附連結。

## Validation / 驗證

List commands actually executed, results, browser when relevant, and any checks not run with the reason.
列出實際執行的指令、結果、必要的瀏覽器資訊，以及未執行檢查的原因。

- [ ] `pnpm check` passed / 通過工程檢查。
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` passed twice with zero retries / 完整 E2E 零重試連續通過兩次。
- [ ] Relevant behavior has meaningful tests; existing tests and mathematical expectations are preserved / 已補充有效測試並保留原有預期。
- [ ] Changed UI includes both languages and appropriate accessibility support / 介面已補齊雙語及無障礙。
- [ ] No credentials, personal learning data, generated builds, or test artifacts are included / 不含憑據、私人學習紀錄或產物。

## Risks or limitations / 風險或限制

Note any persistence version changes, privacy changes, remaining limitations, or third-party asset attribution.
說明儲存版本、隱私行為、剩餘限制或第三方素材來源；無相關項目可填「無」。
